definitions.explanation: A thin, bound publication, typically with a soft cover. Smaller and less substantial than a full book, often used for informational or instructional materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧{冊子|さっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{冊子|さっし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This pamphlet is distributed for free.

notes:
Refers to a thin bound publication, typically stapled or lightly bound, as opposed to a hardcover book. The word covers pamphlets, brochures, and thin booklets of all kinds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧{冊子|さっし}: information booklet / guide
- ⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧{冊子|さっし}: introductory brochure
- ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧{冊子|さっし}: explanatory booklet
- {冊子|さっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a booklet
- {冊子|さっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧: to distribute booklets

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦パンフレット→パンフレット：19127_panfuretto⟧: pamphlet — loanword often used interchangeably, but may refer to unbound folded sheets
- {小冊子|しょうさっし}: small booklet — a diminutive form emphasizing small size
- {本|ほん}: book — a full-length bound book, larger than a {冊子|さっし}
- ⟦チラシ→チラシ：23406_chirashi⟧: flyer — a single unfolded sheet, unlike the multi-page {冊子|さっし}

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ (counter for books/volumes) and {子|し} (diminutive suffix), literally "small volume."
